{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print("Count of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", qa_orders_count)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Count of refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Count of completed orders
completed_count = (df['status'] == 'completed').sum()
print("Count of completed orders:", completed_count)

# Verify total rows
print("Total rows:", len(df))"}
